describe: Progress you keep after a setback. The game declares function `progress_now() -> int` (any int measure of progress: score, wave, distance) and emits `checkpoint_reached` at safe moments. The fragment saves `checkpoint = max(checkpoint, progress_now())` and emits `checkpoint_saved {value}`. When the required event `setback` happens (bind it to `life_lost` from `lives`, or to any game event) it emits `restore_checkpoint {value}` where value is `max(0, checkpoint - penalty)`. It never changes the game itself: the game listens to `restore_checkpoint` and applies the value (set score back, restart a level, reposition the player). Provides `checkpoint: int` and the events `checkpoint_saved` and `restore_checkpoint`. The optional HUD tag shows `<label> n`.
